rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun phrase for the general fact or status of people being present at an event.

example.english: The attendance at this event is pretty good.
example.traditional: 今次活動嘅到場情況唔錯。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 wut6 dung6 ge3 dou3 coeng4 cing4 fong3 m4 co3

rows.note: Use this specifically for the percentage or frequency of being present at recurring activities or events.

example.english: This class has maintained a high attendance rate.
example.traditional: 呢班學生嘅出席率一直都好高。
example.jyutping: ni1 baan1 hok6 saang1 ge3 ceot1 zik6 leot6 jat1 zik6 dou1 hou2 gou1

rows.note: Use this for a list identifying the people who are present.

example.english: We’ll check the attendance list before the meeting starts.
example.traditional: 會議開始前，我哋會核對出席名單。
example.jyutping: wui6 ji5 hoi1 ci2 cin4 ngo5 dei6 wui5 hat6 deoi3 ceot1 zik6 ming4 daan1

rows.note: Use this for a physical or digital sign-in sheet used to record attendance.

example.english: Remember to sign your name on the attendance sheet at the entrance.
example.traditional: 記得喺門口張簽到表度簽名。
example.jyutping: gei3 dak1 hai2 mun4 hau2 zoeng1 cim1 dou3 biu2 dou6 cim1 meng4
